meta.title: Invoice Aging Report: not available on plans below Growth
gaps: Open or use the Invoice Aging Report and generate an aging report by bucket
Verify that the capability is absent or refused on a tenant below Growth
Verify that the same capability works on a Growth tenant
Sign in as the AP Manager or compare tenants by subscription plan
Inspect or change the tenant's plan entitlement
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Open or use the Invoice Aging Report and generate an aging report by bucket; Verify that the capability is absent or refused on a tenant below Growth; Verify that the same capability works on a Growth tenant; Sign in as the AP Manager or compare tenants by subscription plan; Inspect or change the tenant's plan entitlement

args.need: sign in as the AP Manager, check Invoice Aging Report availability and bucketed report generation on a below-Growth tenant, then repeat on a Growth tenant and report whether the capability is absent, refused, or works

steps.note: The catalog has no invoice reporting, plan-entitlement, or AP Manager authentication step.
Verify the session remains free of a crash or server error after the tester's manual comparison; this does not assert the report entitlement itself.
